Orbit Garden Stew

Recipe from Rowan Vale

Adapted by Aster Brook

Updated yesterday

A bright stew with gentle spice.

Serve with moon bread.

Read another article
Total Time
1½ hours
Prep Time
10 minutes
Cook Time
1 hour 20 minutes

Ingredients

Yield:4 servings

For the stew

  • 1 ½ cups/180 grams moon beans

  • 2 cups minus 2 tablespoons cloud flour

  • 1 (28-ounce) can sky tomatoes

To finish

  • 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons pale sugar

  • ½ teaspoon sea salt, to taste

Ingredient Substitution Guide

Preparation

  1. Step 1

    Combine the beans and tomatoes.

    Stir gently.

  2. Step 2

    Simmer until tender.

Tip

  • Cool leftovers promptly.
